headline: PAMOUR MINE DRILLING CONFIRMS 4-KM MINERALIZING SYSTEM AT 300-700m DEPTH — DSV Reports 11,000m in 47 Holes; North Contact and Keora Trend Both Firing (TSX: DSV)
snippet: Discovery Mining (TSX: DSV) released 47-hole results from the Pamour Mine in Ontario's Porcupine district confirming a mineralizing system over 4.0 km at depths of 300-700m — open at depth — with standout intercepts including 3.05 g/t Au over 30m and 11.54 g/t Au over 5.1m at Pamour West/Keora, and 4.27 g/t over 12.8m at the North Contact Zone. The results are part of a 255,000–285,000m 2026 program supporting a new resource update targeted for later this year.

headline: BOFA CUTS GOLD TARGET 14% TO $4,360 BUT CALLS MINERS A 'GOLDEN OPPORTUNITY' — 12% Earnings Yield Highest of Any Sector; Valuation vs S&P 500 at 20-Year Low
snippet: Bank of America equity analysts cut their average 2026 gold price forecast by 14% to US$4,360/oz while simultaneously calling gold miners a "golden opportunity," citing a 12% sector earnings yield (highest in the market), free cash flow 10× higher than 2020, and valuations relative to the S&P 500 at their lowest in nearly two decades. The combination of a downgraded price target with a structural buy signal means BofA's conviction is built on relative value and balance sheet strength — not a near-term gold price recovery.

headline: CATL JIANXIAWO MINE CLEARS RESTART PERMITS — Lithium Crashes 4.95% in One Session on Prospect of 100,000t/yr Returning to Market
snippet: Lithium carbonate fell 4.95% to 144,000 CNY/T on July 21 — its lowest in four months — after CATL's Jianxiawo mine cleared its security permit review, opening the path for the world's largest single lithium operation (~100,000t LCE nameplate, 3% of global supply, 8-10% of China's domestic output) to resume production after a prolonged suspension. Lithium is still 108% higher year-on-year, but the monthly decline of 8.28% signals the market believes the H1 2026 supply deficit is easing as multiple restart programs clear their regulatory hurdles simultaneously.

headline: SPROTT'S PAUL WONG: GOLD AT MINUS-2 TO MINUS-3 STANDARD DEVIATIONS OVERSOLD — Cyclical Bottom Expected Before September; 'Debasement Trade Fully Intact'
snippet: Sprott managing partner Paul Wong told Kitco that gold is at extreme oversold readings across five to six independent metrics — the -2 to -3 standard deviation zone that has historically marked late-stage corrections in long-term bull markets — and that the pullback below the 200-day moving average (first time since October 2023) is driven by short-term catalysts rather than any reversal of the structural debasement and reserve diversification thesis. Wong expects a cyclical bottom before September and characterizes the debasement trade as fully intact.

headline: GOLDGROUP MINING OPENS AS GORO ON NYSE AMERICAN — Merger With Gold Resource Creates Multi-Mine Mexico Precious Metals Producer
snippet: Goldgroup Mining commenced trading on NYSE American as GORO on July 20 following the July 17 closing of its merger with Gold Resource Corporation, creating a Mexico-focused multi-mine precious metals producer spanning the Cerro Prieto mine and San Francisco project in Sonora, the Don David mine in Oaxaca, and the Back Forty project in Michigan. The TSX-V ticker also transitions from GGA to GORO effective approximately July 22, significantly widening institutional access for the combined entity.

headline: ESKAY MINING MOBILIZES 5,000m AT COREY-ESKAY IN BC'S GOLDEN TRIANGLE — Dedicated Stewart Lab Commissioned; Structural Geologist Arrives July 22 (CVE: ESK)
snippet: Eskay Mining Corp. (CVE: ESK) has mobilized drilling at the C-10 prospect on its Corey-Eskay property in BC's Golden Triangle, adjacent to the historic Eskay Creek camp — one of the highest-grade gold-silver deposits ever mined in Canada — launching a 5,000m diamond drill program with structural geologist Dr. Brett Davis joining site July 22. A dedicated rapid-turnaround assay lab in Stewart, BC has been commissioned to cut the results bottleneck that routinely slows remote BC programs.

headline: CHINA RARE EARTH INDEX HITS 271.9 AS DYSPROSIUM SURGES 25.4%, NdPr GAINS 21.4% IN JULY — All 18 Tracked Elements Rise; Heavy RE Buyers Reporting Physical Unavailability
snippet: China's Rare Earth Price Index advanced to 271.9 in July as dysprosium surged 25.4% to US$261.63/kg and NdPr alloy gained 21.4% to US$133.02/kg — the largest single-month moves for both elements in 2026 — with all 18 tracked rare earth elements rising simultaneously for the first time this year. Heavy rare earth buyers outside China are reporting difficulty sourcing qualified material at any price, reflecting Beijing's 98-99% share of separated heavy rare earth output and a second consecutive year of structural supply deficit.

headline: DISTRICT METALS FILES US$2.88B NPV PEA ON WORLD'S LARGEST URANIUM DEPOSIT — 45.9% IRR, 2.1-Year Payback as Sweden's Uranium Permitting Law Takes Effect (TSXV: DMX)
snippet: District Metals Corp. (TSXV: DMX) filed a NI 43-101-compliant PEA for the Viken Energy Metals Project in Sweden — the world's largest undeveloped uranium mineral resource — outlining US$2.88B after-tax NPV(8%), US$876M initial capex, 45.9% IRR, and a 2.1-year payback over a 13-year mine life producing 3.3M lbs U3O8/year plus vanadium, potash, and molybdenum co-products at a net operating cost of (-)US$121/lb U3O8 after by-product credits. The PEA coincides with Sweden's newly enacted uranium extraction permitting framework, which streamlined the regulatory pathway for what the EU has informally designated as its most strategically important uranium project.

headline: ARTISANAL GOLD NOW OUTPRODUCES GHANA'S LARGE-SCALE SECTOR — GoldSeek: ASM Tops 200 Tonnes Across 3 Countries as $4,000 Gold Transforms Small-Scale Economics
snippet: A Metals Focus analysis published on GoldSeek shows artisanal and small-scale mining (ASM) has become a structurally growing component of global gold supply: Ghana's small-scale sector produced 102 tonnes in 2025 — surpassing that country's large-scale mining sector for the first time since 2010 — while Bolivia (55t) and Indonesia (50t) combined for another 105 tonnes from ASM alone. The sustained $4,000+ gold price environment has made previously marginal operations profitable, widened equipment access, and prompted major refiners to expand ASM sourcing programs, reshaping the global supply picture in ways that traditional mine-by-mine analysis misses.
